Apartamenti ndodhet ne nje nga ndertimet me te reja te rr. Dritan Hoxha.

Izolim akustik të plotë.
Kosto minimale përdorimi e mirëmbajtje me eficience energjitike.

- Lokacion strategjik ( aksesi me autostraden Tirane Durres, Fushen e Aviacionit dhe me rrugen Dritan Hoxha ).
Per me shume informacion apo vizite ne prone, jeni te ftuar te me kontaktoni !
description_en: The apartment is located in one of the newest buildings on st. Dritan Hoxha. Property information: Fifth floor Net area: 93.14 m² Gross area: 107.19 m² No. of rooms: 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, spacious corridor. Orientation south west. The technology used in this construction offers: Complete thermal insulation with ventilated facades. Complete acoustic insulation. Minimal cost of use and maintenance with energy efficiency. Other features: - Regular and functional layout. - Strategic location (access with the Tirana Durres highway, the Aviation Field and the Dritan Hoxha road). For more information or a visit to the property, you are welcome to contact me!
